calls.bash: mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --cli "$EVAL_W1" --worktree --task c1 --json
mu agent spawn w2 -w eval --cli "$EVAL_W2" --worktree --task c2 --json
for w in w1; do git cherry-pick "$(git -C "$MU_STATE_DIR/worktrees/eval/$w" rev-parse HEAD)" || exit 1; done
for w in w1; do rev=$(mu agent close $w -w eval | sed -n 's/.*--if \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); [ -n "$rev" ] && mu agent close $w -w eval --if "$rev"; done
